'''Tafasheel Arkan''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Arkan, along with seven other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]]<ref name="WS" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="ERC" /> During that [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] [[Fall of Falleen|attacked]] the planet and destroyed the Republic forces stationed there. All of the Jedi, including Arkan, were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the battle.<ref name="WS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tafasheel Arkan was mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Karen Miller]].<ref name="WS" />
